steps.summary: Every size now belongs to one role on a ten-size ladder, reading copy grows to 17px, and the headline is sized from the column it sits in rather than pushed as large as it would go.

changes.what: The hero headline is sized from its 506px column and its letters open up slightly, so they no longer touch
Section headings drop a weight and a few pixels so the hero stays the one loud moment
Feature, step, plan and FAQ copy is easier to read
The closing call to action's heading joins the section-heading size instead of competing with the hero
Fewer font sizes and weights, and no browser-faked bold
changes.before: 14 sizes, 4 weights, 6 font files, Inter faked at 700
changes.after: 10 sizes, 3 weights, 4 font files, no faked weights

changes.what: The text no longer jumps when the web font arrives
changes.after: Arial fallbacks matched to Inter and Inter Tight (size-adjust 93.9–106.6%)

changes.what: The smallest labels in the product preview are readable

steps.summary: The orange brand stays exactly as it was, but every piece of text and every focus ring that sat on or used it now clears its contrast floor, and every colour has a name for the job it does.

changes.what: Text on the orange tag and buttons switches from white to near-black, so it can be read
Orange eyebrows and links are a deeper orange that passes on white and on the grey sections
The keyboard focus ring can be seen on every background
changes.after: #c0411a, 5.23:1 on white (4.29:1 on the hero glow); #ff9a78, 9.15:1 on the dark bands

changes.what: The quietest grey text gets room above the floor
Off-hours numbers in the planner preview can be read
Pricing check marks are drawn dark enough to see
Every colour is a named token, and the two dark bands re-pick the same names as a local theme

changes.before: 22 (6 features, 3 steps, 3 quotes, 3 plans, 6 FAQ items, 1 closing card)

changes.what: Features, steps and testimonials get room to breathe, each opened by a thin rule
changes.after: 56px rows, 40px columns, a 1px rule above each item

changes.what: The headline sits with its paragraph, apart from the announcement above it
Paragraphs share one line length

changes.what: Hover effects only on devices that can hover
changes.after: 8, all gated on (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)

changes.what: Shadow recipes in the stylesheet
changes.after: 3 tokens: raised, showcase, the best-hour glow
